data.exact_reserve_text: An overall deterioration of GBP 0.1 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. This is due to deteriorations of GBP 0.4 million on casualty reinsurance and GBP 0.2 million on marine reinsurance partially offset by an improvement of GBP 0.5 million on property reinsurance.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Continuation of major bushfires affecting Australia which started in 2019 but continued into 2020; cited among losses mitigated by reinsurance.

named_events.loss_description: Material exposure to losses arising from the COVID-19 pandemic; COVID-19 related net losses GBP 15.7 million.
The largest natural catastrophe loss incurred by the syndicate was in respect of Hurricane Laura.
Continuation of major bushfires affecting Australia which started in 2019 but continued into 2020.
Devastating tornadoes affecting the state of Tennessee.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were GBP 36.754m. During 2020 there was an overall adverse prior-year movement (strengthening) of GBP 0.1m driven by adverse development in Casualty (+GBP 0.4m) and Marine (+GBP 0.2m) partially offset by a release in Property (-GBP 0.5m). The syndicate reported material COVID-19 related net losses (GBP 15.7m) in 2020 and experienced other natural catastrophe activity (Hurricane Laura, Australian bushfires, Tennessee tornadoes), losses from which were largely mitigated by the host syndicate's reinsurance programme.
